Info: As an iOS Software Engineer at Wells Fargo, I streamlined end-to-end testing by integrating BrowserStack with Appium, cutting cross-device testing time by 40% and improving app reliability. Additionally, I contributed to evolving the app’s architecture with MVVM and Coordinator patterns, improving scalability, testability, and rollout speed, while effectively communicating technical decisions with stakeholders.
